parsed.scene_description: A retail aisle view with tall shelving units on both sides stocked with packaged goods. A person walks through the center aisle near a checkout counter area in the background. Decorative hanging lanterns are suspended from the ceiling above the walkway.

objects.label: left shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving on the left side filled with various packaged food items. Shelves extend vertically out of frame. Products include yellow cylindrical containers and bags of chips.

objects.label: right shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving on the right side stocked with packaged goods. Items include bags of snacks and boxes. Shelves extend vertically out of frame.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing dark clothing walking through the center aisle. Back is visible. Positioned between the two shelving units.

objects.label: hanging lanterns
objects.observation: Decorative spherical objects suspended from ceiling. One is yellowish, another reddish/pink. Positioned above the aisle.

objects.label: checkout counter area
objects.observation: Blue structure in background with signage and display items. Appears to be a service point or kiosk.
